# Card Tokenization Request Schema (PAY-2291)

Owner: payments-core. Last reviewed 2025-03. Some sections below are older than that, see notes.

## Top level
- `request_id`: required, string, max 64 chars
- `card`: required, object
- `metadata`: optional, object, max 20 keys, values must be string or number
- `token_policy`: optional, object

## card
- `number` (PAN): required, 13 to 19 digits, Luhn check required. Brand prefix checks: Visa, Mastercard, Amex only. Discover to be added Q2.
- `expiry_month`, `expiry_year`: required. Expiry must be in the future. Max 7 years out. (Changed to 10 years in PAY-2140, not reflected here yet.)
- `cvv`: MUST NOT be persisted. Reject with `CVV_PERSISTENCE_FORBIDDEN` if present in any stored payload. Accepted in `card.cvv_transient` for auth only.

## card.billing.address
- Required unless `token_policy.allow_partial` is true.
- Fields: line1, city, postal_code, country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2).
- Note: unclear whether allow_partial waives the whole address or only postal_code. Ask risk before finalizing.

## token_policy
- `allow_partial`: bool, default false
- `ttl_seconds`: int, 60 to 86400

## Limits and normalization
- Max nesting depth: 5. (Legacy clients still send depth 8, see PAY-1877. Do not break them yet.)
- String fields: NFC-normalize before length checks.
- Null and missing are treated the same for optional fields. `card.number` may never be null.
- Empty strings are rejected for required fields.

TODO: add rate limit rules (see PAY-2305).
